column3: In connection with a workout of any of the Sheraton Denver Downtown Hotel Whole Loan, the 255 Greenwich Whole Loan and the Ellenton Premium Outlets Whole Loan, the related Non-Serviced Special Servicer will be entitled to a workout fee equal to 1.0% of each collection (other than penalty charges) of principal and interest (other than any amount for which a liquidation fee would be paid) made by the related borrower on such corrected Whole Loan for so long as it remains a corrected Whole Loan. Such fee is subject to a floor of $25,000 with respect to any particular workout of such Whole Loan.
